image_description: A vintage black typewriter viewed from the front. The image focuses on the keyboard area, specifically highlighting the long, horizontal key at the bottom center (the space bar). The keys are round with metallic centers and black rims. The body of the typewriter is glossy black metal with gold/brass accents and mechanisms visible in the background.

It is centrally positioned with significant gaps or other structural elements on either side, typical of vintage typewriters, unlike modern computer keyboards where it spans nearly the entire width between modifier keys.

The material appears to be painted metal or hard rubber with a semi-gloss or satin finish, reflecting light differently than modern matte plastic. The surrounding body is clearly glossy metal.
